finding_info.title: MCP tool response repeatedly exceeded output ceiling
finding_info.desc: MCP tool 'list_files' in session 'sess-abc' produced 5 oversized responses (threshold: 10485760 bytes OR 50000 lines per call). The cumulative pattern crossed the operator's repeat threshold (5). This flags resource pressure related to OWASP LLM10:2025 Unbounded Consumption. The threshold crossing does not establish malicious intent, actual charges, or service unavailability. Review tool output limits and legitimate workload requirements.
